findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_visual · Private data: create_diagram, code_to_flowchart, create_sop · Public sink: render_diagram · Destructive: code_to_flowchart, edit_diagram, simulate_process, render_diagram.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_visual · Private data: create_diagram, code_to_flowchart, create_sop · Public sink: render_diagram · Destructive: code_to_flowchart, edit_diagram, simulate_process, render_diagram

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
